what: The WebMCP tool surface the BestPrice.gr storefront registers, read from the source of truth in the bestprice.gr repository.
extraction: webmcp/src/contract-parity.js readStorefrontSurface: title, description and output schema from extra/mcpDiscovery/webmcp-tools.json; input schema and annotations from the object literals the page modules register, with module and imported constants resolved
pagesFrom: tools/scripts/mcp_discovery_json.php webmcp.pages: the manifest the site serves, which the storefront checks against the tools each page registers

search_bestprice.title: Search BestPrice products
search_bestprice.description: Finds products by name, brand, model or category in BestPrice’s catalog; changes nothing.

query.description: A product name, brand, model or category, in Greek or English.

limit.description: Maximum results to return, from 1 to 8. Defaults to 6.

min_price_eur.description: Only products from this price in euros (item price before shipping).

max_price_eur.description: Only products up to this price in euros (item price before shipping).

sort.description: Result order. relevance is the default; newest, biggest_price_drop and most_stores only where offered.

in_stock_only.description: Only products a store has in stock now. Defaults to false.

deals_only.description: Only products priced below their earlier price. Defaults to false.

results_kind.description: listing: a product grid. featured: a category’s highlighted rows. product: one product’s page.

reason.description: not_offered: the page lacks this sort (see offered_sorts). The others: the page could not be narrowed.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

store_offer.description: Links straight to its store; page tools never open it.

reason.description: When given, one of: invalid_argument, timeout, upstream_unavailable, cancelled, unexpected_error.

open_search_results.title: Open search results
open_search_results.description: Opens a search’s results_url in this tab, so the shopper sees those results.

results_url.description: A results_url exactly as a search returned it.

outcome.description: confirmed: results_url was read before the tab moved there. dispatched: it moves there unread.

results_url.description: Where the tab moves, after this answer.

results_kind.description: listing: a product grid. featured: a category’s highlighted rows. product: one product’s page.

unconfirmed_reason.description: Why the destination could not be read first, e.g. timeout.

reason.description: When given, one of: invalid_argument, store_offer, cancelled.

more_pages.description: More result pages exist than this page has loaded.

store_offer.description: Links straight to its store; page tools never open it.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to continue; null at the end.

load_more_products.description: Loads the next page of results into this listing, as scrolling does.

next_offset.description: The first new product: pass it as get_visible_products’ offset.

more_pages.description: More result pages exist than this page has loaded.

get_listing_filters.title: Filters and sort options
get_listing_filters.description: Lists this listing’s filters, their values and its sort options; changes nothing.

group.description: A filter key or name from a previous call; returns that filter with all of its values.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result with the same group, or none. Defaults to 0.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to continue; null at the end.

sort.description: The active sort: its key, or its label when it has none.

key.description: Pass this key, or the name, as apply_listing_sort’s sort.

apply_listing_filter.title: Apply a filter
apply_listing_filter.description: Applies one filter value to this listing and reloads it.

filter.description: A filter name or key as get_listing_filters returned it.

value.description: A value as get_listing_filters returned it; a unique part of it also works.

outcome.description: confirmed: new page read first. observed_complete: applied here. unchanged: already so. Others: read again.

destination_url.description: Where the tab moves, after this answer.

destination.description: The destination as read before the tab moved: its filters, sort, total and first products.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

unconfirmed_reason.description: Why the destination could not be read first, e.g. timeout.

reason.description: When given, one of: invalid_argument, not_found, ambiguous_value, not_available, cancelled.

clear_listing_filters.description: Removes one filter value, one filter or every filter from this listing.

filter.description: Remove only this filter (name or key from get_listing_filters). Without it, every filter goes.

value.description: With filter: remove only this selected value of it.

outcome.description: confirmed: new page read first. observed_complete: applied here. unchanged: already so. Others: read again.

get_page_product.description: Reads the product on this page: id, title, lowest price, store count and rating; changes nothing.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

compare_page_offers.title: Compare store offers
compare_page_offers.description: Ranks this product’s store offers by delivered price, item plus shipping; changes nothing.

limit.description: Offers to return, from 1 to 12. Defaults to 4.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result to read the next offers. Defaults to 0.

include_all_stores.description: First load every store this page holds back, as its all-prices button does. Defaults to false.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.
Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

offer_ref.description: Pass it to show_offer to highlight this offer.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to continue; null at the end.

excluded_unknown_shipping.description: Offers left out because their shipping is unknown; cheapest has the same fields as offers.

offer_ref.description: Pass it to show_offer to highlight this offer.

reason.description: When given, one of: invalid_argument, missing_product, cancelled.

get_product_specifications.title: Product specifications
get_product_specifications.description: Reads this product’s specifications, all or by section or fact; changes nothing.

section.description: all, or a section name a previous call returned; names are in Greek, e.g. Οθόνη (display).

limit.description: Maximum number of specification facts to return, from 1 to 16.

fact.description: A fact name a previous call returned, or a common English one such as screen size or weight.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result with the same section. Defaults to 0; not with fact.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to continue; null at the end.

summarize_price_history.title: Price history
summarize_price_history.description: Summarizes this product’s price history and trend; show_chart also shows the chart.

show_chart.description: Also open or scroll to the price-history chart on this page for the shopper. Defaults to false.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

chart.description: With show_chart: whether the chart was opened, scrolled into view, or unavailable.

show_offer.title: Show a store offer
show_offer.description: Scrolls to one store offer on this page and highlights it; opens no store site.

offer_ref.description: Pass offer_ref (from compare_page_offers) or, failing that, merchant_name. Refused once that offer changes.

merchant_name.description: Only without offer_ref: the store name exactly as compare_page_offers returned it, for one offer.

offer_visible.description: True once the offer is scrolled into the shopper’s view and highlighted.

offer_ref.description: Pass it to show_offer to highlight this offer.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

reason.description: When given, one of: offer_not_found, ambiguous_value, invalid_argument, missing_product, cancelled.

get_shopping_decision.title: Get a shopping decision
get_shopping_decision.description: Recommends what to buy for a described need or budget, with alternatives and reasons; changes nothing.

max_price_eur.description: Highest item price in euros the shopper will pay.

must_have.description: Features the pick must have, one per item, e.g. NFC.

postal_code.description: Optional five-digit Greek delivery postcode the shopper gave; adds shipping and delivered totals.
